landing.heroDescription: Learn systematically with flashcards, quizzes, and immersive reading. Build lasting vocabulary with proven spaced repetition techniques.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to build a strong vocabulary, all in one place.
landing.interactiveQuizzesDesc: Test your knowledge with smart quizzes that adapt to your learning progress. Multiple question types keep learning engaging and effective.
landing.smartFlashcardsDesc: Master vocabulary with spaced repetition flashcards. Our AI-powered system shows you words exactly when you need to review them.
landing.immersiveReadingDesc: Practice reading comprehension with curated content. Click words for instant definitions and add them to your learning collection.
landing.moreFeatures: More Features to Accelerate Your Learning
landing.moreFeaturesSubtitle: Comprehensive tools designed for serious vocabulary learners.
landing.youtubeIntegrationDesc: Learn from real content. Extract vocabulary from YouTube videos with transcripts and timestamps.
landing.smartProgressDesc: Monitor your learning journey with detailed analytics. See your improvement over time.
landing.spacedRepetitionDesc: Scientific learning method that optimizes retention. Review words at the perfect intervals.
landing.personalDictionaryDesc: Build your custom word collection with definitions, examples, and pronunciation guides.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Mindote
landing.faqQ1: How does Mindote help me learn vocabulary?
landing.faqA1: Mindote uses proven learning techniques like spaced repetition, active recall, and contextual learning. You'll study with flashcards, test yourself with quizzes, and see words in real reading contexts. Our AI adapts to your progress, focusing on words you need to practice most.
landing.faqA2: Yes! Mindote is completely free. You can create unlimited word collections, use all flashcard and quiz features, track your progress, and get 3 daily AI generations at no cost.
landing.faqQ3: What is spaced repetition and why does it work?
landing.faqA3: Spaced repetition is a scientifically proven learning technique where you review information at increasing intervals. This method is proven to improve long-term retention by up to 200% compared to traditional studying.
landing.faqQ4: Can I learn from YouTube videos?
landing.faqA4: Absolutely! Mindote integrates with YouTube to extract vocabulary from video transcripts. You can learn words in context, see timestamps, and build your collection from real English content.
landing.faqQ5: How is Mindote different from other vocabulary apps?
landing.faqA5: Mindote combines multiple learning methods in one platform: flashcards, quizzes, reading practice, and YouTube integration. It's designed specifically for serious learners who want a comprehensive, systematic approach to vocabulary building.
landing.faqQ6: Do I need to download anything?
landing.faqA6: No! Mindote is a web application that works in your browser. Just sign up and start learning from any device - computer, tablet, or phone.
landing.ctaDescription: Join thousands of learners who have already improved their English vocabulary with Mindote. Start your journey today—it's completely free!
